answer: Written in a formal notation where applicable, precise language register, it stays short. The pigment of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on oracle aggregation with outlier rejection. Work waits on the tundra until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the kernel of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
